desc:
🔥 Prison Escape v2 is the ultimate prison & open world crime experience! Survive prison life, escape into the city, become a criminal, or enforce the law as a cop! Explore a massive world featuring robberies, police chases, vehicles, weapons, crafting, high bounties, hidden locations and more!

🎁 Join the group for +50% XP!

✅ 21,000+ LIKES = UPDATE!

👮 GUARD / COP: Maintain order inside the prison, stop escapes, patrol the open world, and hunt down wanted criminals!

😢 INMATE: Survive prison life, craft weapons and gear, take control of the prison, or plan your escape!

😈 CRIMINAL: Break out into the open world, commit robberies, build your arsenal, drive vehicles, raid bases, collect bounties, and stay ahead of the law!
